cases.rationale: The kitchen crop shows the sink and faucet, capped bottles by the sink and on the shelf, drinking mugs among the right-side vessels, bowls on the upper shelf, a horizontal knife, spoon-shaped utensils, and hanging scissors with two handle loops. Leaves at the left have a pot context; the cut flowers in the center stand in a separate vase. A possible fork in the crowded utensil cluster is too small and overlapped to distinguish confidently from slotted cooking tools, so fork remains unclear. The counter is a kitchen work surface, not an identifiable dining table. I considered all 75 frozen definitions and their exclusions.

A person's torso and legs dominate the crop, with other people and pedal bicycles behind. Passenger vehicles are visible along the upper edge. The slatted wooden structure is a long bench, and an identifiable skateboard deck lies beneath the foreground person's shoe. A dark item against a background cyclist's back may be a backpack, but its body and straps are insufficiently resolved, so backpack is unclear. The distant white canopy does not establish umbrella structure. All 75 definitions were considered.

Actual red and yellow apples and a curved yellow banana sit in a bowl with a broad yellow rim. The lower-left device is an integrated laptop screen and bezel; its pictured fruit does not add actual objects, and no keyboard is visible. The wooden surface supporting fruit and computer could be an eating table or another work surface, so dining table remains unclear. No orange fruit is identifiable merely from yellow fruit coloring. All 75 frozen definitions were considered; there is no other unresolved category ambiguity.

The foreground object is a parking meter with its payment instructions, dial and control. A real passenger car is immediately behind it, showing door, window, wheel and steering wheel. The dial belongs to the parking meter and is excluded from clock. Seats and reflections inside the car do not identify a person. I considered each of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A cropped human torso, arms, hand and legs hold a large colorful fabricated kite; additional small people are on the grass behind. The kite has an illustrated animal/bird-like face and extended fabric wings, which do not count as an actual bird or animal. The distant small canopies look like tents and do not show identifiable umbrella construction. Each of the 75 definitions was considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A red pedestrian traffic signal with a countdown is clearly identifiable. A small actual pedestrian appears at the lower right; the large face on the upper-right advertisement is printed and does not independently count as a person. The red-and-blue round road sign is not a stop sign. Through the upper restaurant windows, possible chair backs and eating surfaces are partly obscured by rails, glass and reflections; chair and dining table remain unclear. The countdown is not a time-of-day clock. All 75 frozen definitions were considered.

The left edge contains an actual spoon bowl with its handle leaving the crop. Food is arranged on a flat rectangular plate, rather than an identifiable bowl. Two small dark-green clustered pieces could be broccoli florets but lack sufficient detail to rule out other prepared greens; broccoli is unclear. The central yellow porous portion could be a small cake-like preparation or a different cooked/crisp food, so cake is unclear. Neither brown food nor red garnish identifies another listed food category. The cloth surface alone does not establish a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered.

A woman is preparing food above a metal mixing bowl, with a refrigerator covered in magnets behind her. The reddish scraping utensil does not establish a spoon, fork or knife. The foreground round brown mixture is in a preparation vessel and is not identifiable finished cake or pizza. The rear counter contains partly obscured narrow containers whose bottle body/neck identity cannot be resolved, so bottle is unclear. The counter and lower cabinets are kitchen work furniture, not a dining table or identifiable oven. I considered all 75 definitions.

The harbor contains a large passenger boat and smaller working boats with identifiable hulls and superstructures. Actual people are on the boats, and a cropped person stands at the right edge. The foreground green-and-white picnic furniture has a tabletop for eating and long bench seats, supporting dining table and bench rather than individual chair. Vegetation grows in the landscape without identifiable pots. All 75 exact definitions were considered and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A woman and child stand on grass, with another blurred person behind. The child wears a large leather baseball fielding glove with visible fingers and pocket; this is not a batting or ordinary clothing glove. Clothing graphics do not identify additional actual objects. I considered all 75 frozen definitions and found no unresolved category ambiguity.

The desktop has an actual computer keyboard at lower left, a computer mouse at right, and the corner of a standalone monitor at upper left. The round-faced object behind the keyboard is a speaker, with no time markings or hands to establish a clock. The work desk is excluded from dining table, and the monitor is not a laptop-integrated screen. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Several cheese-and-sauce-topped bread portions have identifiable pizza topping/crust context on flat plates. They sit on an eating table with individual dark wooden chairs visible below and along the edges. The two small capped condiment shakers are not identifiable drinking cups or bottles with bottle necks. The white dial object at upper right is a kitchen timer, rather than a time-of-day clock. The plates are flat, not bowls. Each of the 75 frozen definitions was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
